log_file.description: Absolute path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr.

server_port.description: TCP port the server listens on.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

max_players.description: Maximum number of concurrent players across all tables.

enable_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for client connections.

ssl_cert.description: Absolute path to SSL certificate file (required if SSL enabled).

ssl_key.description: Absolute path to SSL private key file (required if SSL enabled).

max_message_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of a client message.

hand_timeout.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) per hand before automatic fold.

action_timeout.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) per player action (e.g., call, raise).

log_actions.description: Log detailed player actions (e.g., folds, raises) for auditing.

default.description: Path to SQLite database file (used when db_backend=sqlite)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this parameter does

db_params.description: Database configuration parameters. Keys and values depend on db_backend.

items.description: IP address (e.g., '192.168.1.100') or CIDR block (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8') to ban.

banned_ips.description: List of banned IP addresses. Each entry is an IP or CIDR range.

password_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the admin's password (without salt, for backward compatibility)

admin_users.description: List of admin users. Format: username:sha256(password)

server_name.description: Public name of the server as displayed to players.

public_listing.description: Whether to advertise this server on the public PokerTH server list.
